title: Disease Prediction from Symptoms
tagline: Compares classical ML classifiers for predicting a disease from a patient’s symptoms.
overview: A machine-learning system trained on datasets covering 500+ diseases and 1,000+ symptoms, comparing several algorithms to improve prediction reliability.
resumePoints: Machine-learning disease prediction system using datasets with 500+ diseases and 1,000+ symptoms.
Applied and compared multiple algorithms to improve prediction reliability.
